scope: Selected positive exploratory comparisons, not a complete evaluation inventory or an independent confirmation.
paper_equivalence: Maze-family extension; not an equation-equivalent reproduction or a result reported in the NeurIPS paper.
token_scope: Simulated consumed-prefix target input plus output, including full prompt rereads. Source, encoder, tokenizer, planner, parser and audit overhead are additional. Not measured latency, monetary savings or physically avoided calls.
uncertainty: Previously computed unadjusted paired question-cluster bootstrap intervals, with conditional replicates kept together. Not adjusted for outcome-informed search. Aggregate records cannot reconstruct these intervals.
reproducibility: Arithmetic and public-table consistency only. Source hashes bind private completed summaries; source records and question-level research archives are not distributed. No target generation, voting replay, regrading or independent audit is supplied by this highlight file.

cohorts.MMLU-Pro64: 64 exposed science/math questions across four categories; repeated-primary selected for emphasis after outcomes.
cohorts.BBEH43: 43 exposed questions across 21 categories. Role study refreshes only 15 input-defined scarcity cases; all other questions remain cached.
cohorts.Full exposed panel171: GPQA64 + MMLU-Pro64 + BBEH43. One benchmark rule selected after earlier outcomes; 156 questions duplicate cached observations across conditional replicates. Cached controls are not new matched-seed replications.

qualifications: Gains are comparator-specific. Raw adaptive remains cheaper on the highlighted panels; BBEH memory points do not establish superiority over Raw8.
Matched-seed follow-ups show seed sensitivity and do not establish a consistent advantage over matched Raw continuation.
Role-repeat improves only one fresh scarcity-case answer in one of two conditional replicates; role/no-gate aliases provide no gate-specific efficacy contrast.
The portfolio uses Raw adaptive on GPQA and role-repeat on MMLU-Pro/BBEH; it is an outcome-informed synthesis, not a universally learned router or a fresh full-panel result.
No neural causality, broad superiority or statistical confirmation follows from these highlights.

research_cost_context.amortization: Only over an explicitly stated future-query count. GPU tariff and some historical overhead remain unresolved. Later ongoing collection is separate and has no result in this export.
